title: enchant
description: Adds an enchantment to a player's selected item.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

enchantmentname.title: enchantmentName
enchantmentname.description: An enum for the enchantment that is applied.

level.title: level
level.description: Optional. An `integer` that specifies the enchantment level.

enchantmentid.title: enchantmentId
enchantmentid.description: An integer ID for the enchantment that is applied.
